phrases.latin: nam patris, quī etiam tum dormiēbat, palpebram digitō sublevāvit, ut explōrāret num vigilāret
phrases.english: for he lifted his sleeping father’s eyelid with a finger, to find out whether he was awake
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 58, 312.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. eyelid.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
